TfrmMain.DoImport.text: Handler (Ctrl+I): Import. Asks for a design file (the Design files filter) and brings its first sheet into this sheet as a block that follows the mouse until it is placed. The Open dialog's settings are put back afterwards, so Open is not affected.

TfrmMain.ImportDesign.text: Import without the dialog: puts any drawing tool away and clears the selection (as TinyCAD does), then reads the design into this sheet as a block that follows the mouse. A file that cannot be opened is reported; one that is not a TinyCAD design that can be imported (not XML, empty) is reported and changes nothing.
TfrmMain.ImportDesign.returns: how many objects were read, 0 if none
